strategies.name: Detection of Block Operational Technology Message

analytics.name: Analytic 2046
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies iptables/nftables rule changes on Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux gateways that selectively block one ICS communication traffic type. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.

tuning.description: Time threshold beyond the expected communication interval that constitutes a gap warranting investigation.

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): syscall=execve; command line invokes iptables/nftables to change ICS traffic filtering or redirection outside the authorized network-administration baseline

analytics.name: Analytic 2213
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies an abrupt cessation of expected Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol traffic between a Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA)/control server and a field device, without a corresponding device alarm or scheduled maintenance event, while the device remains reachable for at least some traffic types. This technique-level analytic synthesizes Command Message blocking (T1691.001) and Reporting Message blocking (T1691.002). OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.

tuning.description: Time threshold beyond the expected communication interval that constitutes a gap warranting investigation.

log_sources.name: operationaldb:AlarmEvent
log_sources.channel: expected communication absent for device_ip without corresponding device-generated alarm explaining the gap

log_sources.name: NSM:Connections
log_sources.channel: one Industrial Control System (ICS) traffic type (command or reporting) to/from device_ip ceases while other traffic types continue normally
